name.ja: BB戦士309 夏侯淵ダラス

ja: ●BB戦士三国伝より、機駕の猛将“夏侯淵ダラス”が登場 ●パーツの組み換えで様々な形態になる武器が付属 ●鎧の着脱により軽装形態を再現、鎧は他の三国伝キャラと交換可能
en: -From BB Senshi Sangokuden, the fierce commander of the machine "Natsuhouen Dallas" appears -Weapons that can be changed into various forms by recombining parts are included -Lightly armored form can be reproduced by attaching and removing armor, and armor can be replaced with other Sangokuden characters
